result.reason: The episode adds one mechanically supported catalog unit and another correctly bounded evaluator trial, but it lacks fresh remote exact-head CI, active model-driven selection, repeated cross-context benefit, and any independent external evidence needed to generalize or activate a Candidate.
retained_learning: Catalog metadata can expose child summaries without reading Skill content, preserving selected-only materialization.
Freshness must be revalidated at the point of use against immutable manifest and content digests.
Semantic relevance belongs to a model selection boundary; deterministic code should enforce identity, provenance, freshness, path confinement, replay protection, and budgets.
A local unit remains incomplete until its native records, isolated remote head, and fresh exact-head CI are mutually bound and read back.
Primary and secondary branch, run, lease, PR, and workflow isolation must remain explicit until serialized integration.
